paper.title_en: FLARE: an open-source data workflow orchestration tool
paper.abstract_en: Flare is an open-source Python-based data workflow orchestration tool powered by b2luigi. It automates the workflow of Monte Carlo (MC) generators inside the Key4HEP stack, such as Whizard, MadGraph5 and Pythia8, together with fast detector simulation using Delphes. It also automates the Future Circular Collider (FCC) physics analysis software workflow. These workflows are combined, giving a user an automated pipeline from MC production to final FCCAnalyses histograms. With its customisation options and Python API, Flare simplifies executing FCC-ee analyses, especially when custom MC events are required.
